data.long_description:
Emaar is excited to introduce Greenview, an exceptional community where each villa is meticulously crafted to blend seamlessly with the natural surroundings while reflecting your personal style. Offering two sophisticated architectural designs, these elegant villas feature expansive windows that frame stunning views of beautifully manicured communal areas, lush parks, and immaculate green lawns.


  Property Details:


 3 Bedrooms
 4 Bathrooms
 2 Parking Spaces
 Area: 1,518.14 sq.ft.
 Community View
 Vastu-Compliant
 Maids Room
 Study Room


  Greenview boasts direct access to the Etihad rail network, the new Al-Maktoum International Airport, and Palm Jebel Ali Port, ensuring seamless connectivity. Nestled within Emaar South, the community is renowned for its abundant green spaces, an 18-hole golf course, and a prestigious golf club, promoting an eco-conscious lifestyle. The comprehensive master plan envisions large parks, dedicated bike paths, vibrant shopping centers, and luxury hotels, making Greenview the perfect haven for families and individuals looking for a harmonious and fulfilling living experience.
